veo.name: Google Veo
veo.prompt_style: Rich cinematic description in flowing sentences with camera, lens and lighting terms. Describe sound separately in the audio field (music mood, ambience, sound effects; no sung lyrics, no dialogue).

kling.name: Kling
kling.prompt_style: Concise and motion-first: subject, one clear physical action, then the camera move. Avoid long adjective lists.

hailuo.name: Hailuo (MiniMax)
hailuo.prompt_style: Short and motion-first: who, what physical movement, how the camera moves. Plain concrete words.

sora.name: OpenAI Sora
sora.prompt_style: Flowing natural-language scene description, like one paragraph of a screenplay, describing subject, setting, motion and camera in continuous prose.

runway.name: Runway
runway.prompt_style: One or two continuous descriptive sentences: camera move, subject and action, setting and light. Positive phrasing only (no 'no ...' clauses).
